title: Deterministic query index pair
statement: Let $Q$ be the product of the outer and inner sample counts for a restricted weight input. Each index $q	ext{ with }0\le q<Q$ determines the corresponding pair of indices, one in the outer sample range and one in the inner sample range, under the standard equivalence between a finite range of size equal to a product and the product of the two ranges.
hypotheses_covered: An index in the range from $0$ to the product of its outer and inner sample counts
